The guard's verbatim state lives in one child list, counts no nesting, and ends with each block, so --write still exits 0 after changing text inside 
/: 'Use 
a 
b
 c. Then more text
d
 here.' (nested, plain paragraph), 'Use a b c
d here.', '> Quote *x 
y*
line one
line two
' (open tag inside emphasis), 'Use 
x

Next b. Then c
d.' (an unclosed 
 holds the next paragraph). Fix that ends the class: in the guard, keep a block's text exact when its subtree holds any verbatim open tag, and keep later blocks exact while a verbatim element opened earlier is unclosed (open and close counted by name, in document order). Refusal is the intended outcome; no guide holds such a tag.

VERBATIM_OPEN's lookahead lacks \r, so in a CRLF file 'a. Then b\r\nc' is not read as 
: --write exits 0 and cuts inside it. Add \r to the lookahead.
Cites 'the "Listener API" table of packages/envoy/AGENTS.md'; that section is a list now. Reword it as the PR reworded the in-file table references.
